heroTitle: Happy Princess Day, My Prettiest Princess 👑❤️
heroSub: If I could make a wish come true, it would be to remind you every day how wonderfully special you are.
memorySub: Every picture holds a little piece of my favourite story.
momentsSub: A few favourite chapters in our story.
closingMessage: No crown could ever shine as brightly as your heart. Thank you for making ordinary days feel like a fairytale. Here's to every beautiful chapter still waiting for us. ♥
letterText: Happy Princess Day my prettiest princess ❤️ I just want you to know how special you are and how much you deserve all the happiness in this world. No matter how difficult things get, always remember that you're strong, capable and never alone. I hope you never stop believing in yourself, chasing your dreams and smiling that beautiful smile. I'll always wish to see you happy, loved and successful. You deserve nothing less than the most beautiful things in life. Always keep shining, my princess my babyyyyy. ❤️🫶🏻
